title.justification: The title of the paper is directly provided as "Representational Ethical Model Calibration."

extractions.description: This paper proposes a framework for ensuring equity in healthcare model decisions by introducing the concept of Representational Ethical Model Calibration. It utilizes representation learning to evaluate and rectify inequity in predictive models across diverse subpopulations, using large-scale data from UK Biobank as a demonstration.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The primary focus of the paper is on epistemic equity and ethical considerations in healthcare models, not directly on climate or ecological impacts.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Equity is widely held to be fundamental to the ethics of healthcare... We offer our approach as a principled solution to quantifying and assuring epistemic equity in healthcare.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not relate directly to any climate or ecological sustainable development categories; its central theme is healthcare equity.
primary_category.quote: We offer our approach as a principled solution to quantifying and assuring epistemic equity in healthcare, with applications across the research, clinical, and regulatory domains.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not cover topics related to any specific sub-categories of climate or ecological sustainable development; it is focused on healthcare model equity.
primary_sub_category.quote: ... epistemic equity arises in the context of any decision guidance, whether traditional or innovative.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on ethical considerations and equity in healthcare model decisions, proposing a framework for assuring fairness and equity through modeling approaches.
new_primary_category.quote: We offer our approach as a principled solution to quantifying and assuring epistemic equity in healthcare.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The framework proposed by the paper focuses on ensuring equity in model performance across diverse subpopulations.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Here we propose such a framework, termed Representational Ethical Model Calibration.
